entities.summary: The Qingdao University of Science and Technology (QUST) is a provincial public university located in Qingdao, China. Having evolved from a college specializing in the chemical industry, it is now a comprehensive, multi-disciplinary university offering academic degrees in Science, Technology, Humanities, Business, Management, Medicine, Law and Arts.
